name: ChainSentinel
title: ChainSentinel · Crypto AML Risk Screening for AI Agents
description: On-chain AML and risk screening service for TRON, BTC and ETH addresses. Detects OFAC SDN sanctions addresses, blacklists, scam and laundering-linked funds. Autonomous agents can call it with no signup; high-volume use is paid with non-custodial TRON USDT prepaid credits.

skills.name: Check address risk
skills.description: Screen a TRON/BTC/ETH address for AML risk in ~3 seconds. Returns level, score, reasons and evidence links.
examples: Check this TRON address before receiving USDT

skills.name: Check prepaid balance
skills.description: Read remaining USD credits and call count for a cs_agent_* credential.
examples: How many API calls do I have left?

skills.name: Get top-up instructions
skills.description: Return the TRON USDT payment address, price per call, minimum top-up and exact machine-followable steps. A one-time quote (POST /api/v1/quote) is required before paying: its unique 6-decimal amount binds the transfer to the claim.
examples: I got a 402 PAYMENT_REQUIRED, what do I do?

compliance: Read-only risk screening. No trading execution, no custody, no private keys, no sanctions-evasion assistance. Risk signals, not legal advice.
note: This is a discovery document in the agent-card convention. The service is a stateless REST/JSON-RPC API, not an A2A task-based agent.
